name: rcore-session-archive
description: Archives readable Markdown conversations inside the local rCore checkout

interface.shortDescription: Read each agent session as a local Markdown document.
interface.longDescription: Archives Codex and Claude Code conversations as Markdown under .agent-sessions. Choose messages only, messages plus tool calls, or full conversation text with intermediate output and tool results. No raw JSON backup is kept.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me where this project archives coding-agent sessions.
